task.swarm_objective: Assess which public cloud and infrastructure providers are monetizing AI most effectively, using recent filings and earnings information.
task.agent_directive: Investigate Amazon Web Services (AWS) segment revenue growth and operating income over recent quarters, and how AI workloads contribute, with cited figures.
constraints: Cite a source for every financial figure you record.
Use the most recently reported fiscal periods.
Focus on the AWS segment, not the rest of Amazon.
success_criteria: Report AWS revenue and operating income for recent quarters
Explain AI's contribution to AWS growth
Benchmark AWS growth against at least one competing cloud provider

tool_arguments.query: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q2 2026 quarterly results Amazon

events.content: AWS segment revenue and operating income Q2 2026 quarterly results Amazon

AWS generated **$42.232 billion of net sales (segment revenue)** in Amazon’s Q2 2026, the three months ended June 30, 2026, up 37% from $30.873 billion in Q2 2025. [[1]] 

AWS reported **$16.621 billion of operating income** in Q2 2026, versus $10.160 billion a year earlier; this equates to an operating margin of approximately **39.4%** of AWS revenue. [[2]] [[1]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/
[S1.2] Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260729379483/en/Amazon.com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results

source_references.title: Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results
Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results

tool_arguments.query: AWS AI contribution revenue Q2 2026 Amazon Andy Jassy

events.content: AWS AI contribution revenue Q2 2026 Amazon Andy Jassy

- **AWS growth:** AWS revenue was **$42.2 billion in Q2 2026**, up **36.7% year over year**—its fastest growth in 18 quarters—and Amazon said the business reached a **$169 billion annualized revenue run rate**. [[1]]

- **AI-revenue disclosure:** Amazon said AWS’s **AI business exceeded a $25 billion annual revenue run rate** and was growing at a **triple-digit year-over-year rate**; this equates to more than **$6.25 billion on a simple quarterly run-rate basis** and at least roughly **15% of AWS’s $169 billion annualized revenue**, although Amazon did not formally disclose quarterly AI revenue or its precise share of AWS growth. [[1]]

- **Management’s key comment on workload contribution:** Andy Jassy said AWS was seeing strong growth in both **AI** and **non-AI (“core”)** workloads, with each supporting the other rather than AI being an isolated revenue stream. [[2]]

- **Mechanism:** Management said AI adoption encourages customers to move to AWS and increases core-service consumption; moreover, post-training reinforcement learning and AI-agent tool use are largely CPU-intensive, benefiting AWS core compute as well as AI accelerators. [[3]]

- **Important caveat:** Therefore, it would be inaccurate to attribute all—or a defined portion—of the 36.7% AWS growth rate to AI: Amazon disclosed rapid AI revenue growth, but **did not quantify AI’s percentage-point contribution** to Q2 AWS growth. [[3, 1]]

Sources:
[S2.1] Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results — https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Second-Quarter-Results/
[S2.2] Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Q2 FY2026 earnings call transcript — https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMZN/earnings/AMZN-Q2-2026-earnings_call-657334.html
[S2.3] Amazon (AMZN) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/07/amazon-amzn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/

tool_arguments.query: Microsoft Azure revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarterly results

events.content: Microsoft Azure revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarterly results

Microsoft reported that **Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 40% year over year** in fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026), or **39% in constant currency**. [[1]] 

Microsoft does **not** disclose a standalone quarterly dollar-revenue figure for Azure; it reports Azure within the broader Intelligent Cloud segment, whose Q3 FY2026 revenue was **$34.7 billion**, up **30%** year over year. [[2]] 

For context, total Microsoft Cloud revenue was **$54.5 billion**, up **29%** year over year, while company-wide revenue was **$82.9 billion**, up **18%**. [[1]]

Sources:
[S3.1] FY26 Q3 - Press Releases - Investor Relations - Microsoft — https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2026-q3/press-release-webcast
[S3.2] Microsoft Fiscal Year 2026 Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call — https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/events/fy-2026/earnings-fy-2026-q3

tool_arguments.query: Microsoft Azure AI contribution revenue growth fiscal Q3 2026

events.content: Microsoft Azure AI contribution revenue growth fiscal Q3 2026

In Microsoft’s fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026), Azure and other cloud-services revenue grew **40% year over year** (**39% in constant currency**). [[1]] 

AI services contributed approximately **12 percentage points** of that Azure growth, versus roughly **9 points** in the prior-year quarter; therefore, AI was about **30% of Azure’s reported 40% growth rate** (12 ÷ 40), with non-AI services accounting for the remaining ~28 points. [[2]] 

Separately, Microsoft said its total AI business reached a **$37 billion annual revenue run rate**, up **123% year over year**. [[3]]
